bio.text: Ruslan Shamal is a candidate for New York State Senate, according to his campaign website, which describes a district that includes parts of Staten Island and Brooklyn.
According to his campaign website, he came to the United States from Belarus, worked blue-collar jobs, built a small business and became a longtime radio host.
The site says he lives on Staten Island and works in Brooklyn.
